screening.screening_rationale: Patient provides coherent, detailed photo description with appropriate concrete visual details. Speech demonstrates logical organization, clear spatial relationships, and relevant observations. No evidence of thought disorder across any TALD domains.

Patient delivers organized photo description with specific visual details and spatial relationships. Demonstrates abstract thinking ability by characterizing artistic style as sketchy almost abstract. Speech maintains coherent focus on photo elements without disorder markers.

Patient provides spatially organized photo description with detailed visual elements. Minor speech disfluencies (stuttered article, phrase redundancy) reflect normal spontaneous speech variation rather than pathological thought disorder. Description maintains coherent focus and contextual appropriateness throughout.
